plan-core.title: Core pipeline, AST, preprocess, HTML helpers

task-ast.title: Define BlockNode/InlineNode unions + LinkRef; sync contracts
task-ast.notes: Implement the discriminated unions exactly as DESIGN.md AST section. Export LinkRef type. Do not add parsers.

report.summary: 在 src/types.ts 中按 DESIGN.md 实现 BlockNode/InlineNode 判别联合、LinkRef、LinkRefMap、BlockParseContext 与 InlineContext；在 contracts.ts 导出全部 AST 与上下文类型。为通过 tsc，最小 cross-scope 更新 BlockParser 第三参数 ctx，以及 index/render 使用 paragraph.children。
report.guide_note: LinkRef 不在 AST 内：refs Map 在块解析阶段填充，行内阶段通过 InlineContext 只读使用（与块先于行内的两阶段解析一致）。

task-preprocess.title: Line normalization: CRLF + tab expansion
task-preprocess.notes: Export normalizeInput(md): string and expandTabs(line)/splitLines helpers. Tab stops every 4 columns per CommonMark.

report.summary: 新增 src/preprocess.ts：splitLines（\r\n/\r→LF 后按行切分）、expandTabs（4 列制表位展开）、normalizeInput（逐行展开后拼回）。在 index.ts 的 renderMarkdown 中接入 normalizeInput，使块解析走规范化后的行。已通过 npm run build。
report.guide_note: Tab stops in expandTabs advance column by Unicode code point (for..of on the line string), not UTF-16 code unit index.

task-html-util.title: HTML escape helper
task-html-util.notes: escapeHtml for & < > ". Used by render and attribute emission.

report.summary: 新增 `src/html.ts`，导出 `escapeHtml`：按顺序将 `&`、`<`、`>`、`"` 转为 `&`、`<`、`>`、`"`，供后续 render 与属性输出使用。已通过 `npm run build` 并提交。

task-block-state.title: BlockState + registry ctx signature
task-block-state.notes: BlockParser(lines, pos, ctx)->{node,next}|null; ctx has refs Map, optional open stack. getBlockParsers preserves registration order.

report.summary: Added src/blocks/state.ts with BlockParseContext, createBlockParseContext(), and open-stack mutators; registry BlockParser ctx type points at state; contracts re-exports; DESIGN.md documents ctx location. cross-scope: types.ts + index.ts wired to the factory.
report.guide_note: BlockParseContext lives in blocks/state.ts (not types.ts); import via contracts for parser workers.

task-thematic.title: Thematic breaks parser
task-thematic.notes: Register via side-effect export register() called from index. Match ***, ---, ___ rules with indent ≤3.

report.summary: 新增 src/blocks/thematic.ts：isThematicBreakLine（前导空格≤3、≥3 个同种 -/_/*，行间仅空白）及 BlockParser；index 调用 register()；render 输出 <hr />。本地 build 与规范样例（***/---/___、+++ 非 hr、四空格 indent、- - -、段落中断）已自测。

task-atx.title: ATX headings parser
task-atx.notes: Levels 1–6; optional closing #; content as raw string for later inline parse (store in node temporarily as `text` then normalize to children in pipeline).

report.summary: Implemented `src/blocks/atx.ts`: CommonMark ATX headings (1–6 leading `#`, up to 3 spaces indent, opening `#` followed by space/tab or EOL, optional unescaped closing `#` run preceded by space/tab). Raw title stored as a single `text` child for later inline pass. Self-registers via `registerBlockParser`. cross-scope: side-effect import in `index.ts`; `render.ts` emits `<h1>`–`<h6>` and escapes text.
report.guide_note: Seven or more opening `#` on one line fails ATX (falls through to paragraph), even if only six were counted as the opening run.

task-setext.title: Setext headings parser
task-setext.notes: May convert preceding paragraph lines via ctx. Coordinate with paragraph parser.

report.summary: Implemented src/blocks/setext.ts: setext underline detection (= h1, - h2), backward content collection with non-paragraph line guards, raw content trim/join, ctx.setextPop for replacing prior fallback paragraphs. Registered after thematic; thematic defers via isValidSetextAt. cross-scope: state.setextPop, index pop+register, render h1/h2, DESIGN.md note.
report.guide_note: Thematic break parser must defer when isValidSetextAt(lines, pos) — `-` underlines win over `---` HR when preceded by paragraph text.

task-indent-code.title: Indented code blocks
task-indent-code.notes: 4-space indent; blank-line handling; literal without leading indent.

report.summary: Added src/blocks/indent_code.ts: 4-space dedent, multi-chunk blank-line handling, trailing blank exclusion via lookahead, paragraph-interruption guard (ctx.open paragraph + prior non-block line). Registered parser in index.ts; minimal codeBlock HTML in render.ts for self-check. Spec examples verified via CLI.
report.guide_note: Indented code: trailing blank lines after the last indented line stay outside the block; blanks between chunks require a following line with ≥4 leading spaces.

task-fence.title: Fenced code blocks
task-fence.notes: ` and ~ fences; info string → lang; closing fence rules.

report.summary: 实现 CommonMark 围栏代码块：解析 opening（≤3 空格 + 3+ 同种 `/~、反引号 info 禁含 `）、info 首词作 lang、按 opening 缩进剥内容行、闭合行（≤3 空格、同字符、长度≥ opening、行尾仅空白）；未闭合则吃到文档/块结束。cross-scope：在 index 注册 parser。
report.guide_note: 闭合围栏按整段 run 计数，须 ≥ opening 长度；行上 ``` aaa 因 trailing 非空白不算闭合行。

task-html-block.title: HTML blocks (types 1–7)
task-html-block.notes: Implement all seven HTML block start/end conditions; emit htmlBlock literal.

report.summary: 新增 html_block 解析器（类型 1–7 分类、缩进≤3、类型 7 段落打断限制、按规范消费行并 emit htmlBlock.literal）；cross-scope 注册与渲染以便 build/CLI 验证。
report.guide_note: Type 7 complete tag: after `>`, i === line.length is valid success.

task-link-ref.title: Link reference definitions
task-link-ref.notes: Parse [label]: dest 'title'; normalize label; first definition wins; no HTML output.

task-blockquote.title: Block quotes
task-blockquote.notes: Strip > markers; recurse into block parse for inner lines; lazy continuations per CM.

task-lists.title: List items and lists
task-lists.notes: Bullet/ordered markers; width/indent rules; tight vs loose; nested lists; produce list+listItem nodes.

task-paragraph.title: Paragraphs + blank line skipping
task-paragraph.notes: Paragraph as fallback with lazy continuation; blank parser only advances pos. Interruption rules for other blocks.

task-escapes-entities.title: Backslash escapes + entity references
task-escapes-entities.notes: ASCII punctuation escapes; &name; &#dec; &#xhex; export scanners returning text replacement + next pos.

task-code-span.title: Code spans
task-code-span.notes: Backtick fence matching; strip one leading/trailing space rule; normalize interior newlines to space.

task-emphasis.title: Emphasis and strong emphasis
task-emphasis.notes: Full CM delimiter-stack algorithm (* and _). Export processEmphasis(delimiters).

task-links-images.title: Inline/reference links and images
task-links-images.notes: Inline, full, collapsed, shortcut refs; destination/title parsing; images analog with !. Use ctx.refs.

task-autolink-raw.title: Autolinks + raw inline HTML
task-autolink-raw.notes: URI/email autolinks in <…>; tag/comment/PI/CDATA/declaration per CM raw HTML.

task-breaks-text.title: Hard/soft breaks + textual content + parseInline
task-breaks-text.notes: Wire parseInline(text, ctx)->InlineNode[]; spaces-before-\n / trailing \\ hard breaks; softbreak otherwise; integrate all scanners + emphasis pass.

task-render.title: AST → HTML renderer
task-render.notes: Cover all block/inline types per DESIGN emit rules; tight list handling; recurse children.

task-wire.title: Wire index.ts: normalize → blocks → inlines → render
task-wire.notes: Register block parsers in DESIGN order; after block parse, run parseInline on text-bearing nodes; call render. Keep cli.ts unchanged unless needed.
